parameters.label: Text shown on the action.
parameters.onPressed: Runs the action. Pass null to disable it.
parameters.isDefaultAction: Draws the default action with a ringed frame.
parameters.isDestructiveAction: Marks an action that deletes or destroys.
parameters.size: Selects the size of the button face.
parameters.wide: Fills the available width below 600 logical pixels.
parameters.busy: Blocks repeated activation while the action is in progress.
parameters.showBusy: Controls whether the hourglass is drawn.
parameters.icon: Adds a glyph beside the label.
parameters.iconOnPhone: Shows only the icon on a phone.
parameters.focusNode: Uses a focus node owned by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests keyboard focus when the button appears.
